sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What is <bdi>اِسْم المُبَالَغَة</bdi> also called?
sarf.back: <bdi>صِيغَة المُبَالَغَة</bdi> (ṣīghat al-mubālaghah)

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: How does <bdi>اِسْم المُبَالَغَة</bdi> relate to <bdi>اِسْم الفَاعِل</bdi>?
sarf.back: It is the ism fāʿil with more intensity — <bdi>عَالِم</bdi>, one who knows; <bdi>عَلَّام</bdi>, one who knows a great deal

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: How many forms of <bdi>اِسْم المُبَالَغَة</bdi> can a single root yield?
sarf.back: Sometimes several — <bdi>عَلِمَ</bdi> gives both <bdi>عَلَّام</bdi> and <bdi>عَلِيم</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.text: Some patterns of <bdi>اِسْم المُبَالَغَة</bdi>: {{c1::<bdi>فَعَّال</bdi>}}, {{c2::<bdi>مِفْعَال</bdi>}}, {{c3::<bdi>فَعُول</bdi>}}, {{c4::<bdi>فَعِيل</bdi>}} — and there are more

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: A word on <bdi>فَعِيل</bdi> or <bdi>فَعُول</bdi> could be <bdi>الصِّفَة المُشَبَّهَة</bdi> or <bdi>اِسْم المُبَالَغَة</bdi>. What tells them apart?
sarf.back: The meaning: a long-term, intrinsic quality makes it <bdi>الصِّفَة المُشَبَّهَة</bdi> — <bdi>كَرِيم</bdi>, generous by nature; the ism fāʿil's action with more intensity makes it <bdi>اِسْم المُبَالَغَة</bdi> — <bdi>غَفُور</bdi>, forgiving a great deal

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: Which two derived nouns share the pattern <bdi>مِفْعَال</bdi>?
sarf.back: <bdi>اِسْم المُبَالَغَة</bdi>, as in <bdi>مِقْدَام</bdi>, very bold; and <bdi>اِسْم الآلَة</bdi>, as in <bdi>مِفْتَاح</bdi>, a key

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What is the pattern of <bdi>اِسْم التَّفْضِيل</bdi>?
sarf.back: <bdi>أَفْعَلُ</bdi> — <bdi>أَكْبَرُ</bdi>, greater or greatest

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: How is the comparative or superlative expressed for a <bdi>مَزِيد فِيه</bdi> verb?
sarf.back: With <bdi>أَكْثَرُ</bdi> (more in number) or <bdi>أَشَدُّ</bdi> (more in intensity), followed by the verb's <bdi>مَصْدَر</bdi> — <bdi>أَكْثَرُ اسْتِغْفَارًا</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What does <bdi>ظَرْف</bdi> literally mean?
sarf.back: A container

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.extra: <bdi>مَجْلِس</bdi>, a sitting place; <bdi>مَكْتَب</bdi>, an office; <bdi>مَدْرَسَة</bdi>, a school.

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What rule decides which pattern an <bdi>اِسْم الظَّرْف</bdi> takes?
sarf.back: None that is hard and fast — each word's pattern is learned with the word

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.extra: <bdi>مِبْرَد</bdi>, a file; <bdi>مِكْنَسَة</bdi>, a broom; <bdi>مِفْتَاح</bdi>, a key. Rule of thumb: unvowelled, a word that could be either this or <bdi>اِسْم الظَّرْف</bdi> is more likely <bdi>اِسْم الظَّرْف</bdi> — guess that first, it is the more common.

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.meaning: the nūn of emphasis — added to a verb to make it emphatic

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What does <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi> do to the time a <bdi>مُضَارِع</bdi> refers to?
sarf.back: Restricts it to the future

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What often comes with <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi>, though it isn't required?
sarf.back: <bdi>لَام التَّوْكِيد</bdi>, the lām of emphasis — <bdi>لَيَفْتَحَنَّ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.text: <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi> comes in two kinds: {{c1::<bdi>الثَّقِيلَة</bdi>}}, with a shaddah — <bdi>لَيَفْتَحَنَّ</bdi> — and {{c2::<bdi>الخَفِيفَة</bdi>}}, without one — <bdi>لَيَفْتَحَنْ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What is <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد الخَفِيفَة</bdi> mostly used for?
sarf.back: Flow — it is the rarer of the two

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: Where does <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد الخَفِيفَة</bdi> appear in the Qurʾān?
sarf.back: Twice: <bdi>لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ</bdi> (96:15), and <bdi>وَلَيَكُونًا مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ</bdi> (12:32), right after <bdi>لَيُسْجَنَنَّ</bdi> with the heavy nūn

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: Which forms cannot take <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد الخَفِيفَة</bdi>?
sarf.back: The duals and the feminine plurals

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What problem does <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi> cause in pronunciation?
sarf.back: <bdi>اِلْتِقَاء السَّاكِنَيْن</bdi> — two sukūns meeting

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: With <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi>, what happens to the verb's lām in the forms with no suffix?
sarf.back: Its ḍammah becomes a fatḥah — <bdi>يَفْتَحُ</bdi> → <bdi>يَفْتَحَنَّ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: With <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi>, what happens to the <bdi>نُون الإِعْرَاب</bdi>?
sarf.back: It drops — <bdi>يَفْتَحُونَ</bdi> → <bdi>يَفْتَحُنَّ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: With <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi>, what happens to the pronouns wāw and yāʾ?
sarf.back: They drop, and the vowel before them stays — <bdi>يَفْتَحُنَّ</bdi>, <bdi>تَفْتَحِنَّ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: Why does the dual keep its alif before <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi>, despite the two sukūns meeting?
sarf.back: So that it isn't confused with the singular — <bdi>يَفْتَحَانِّ</bdi>, not <bdi>يَفْتَحَنَّ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: With <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد</bdi>, what is added to the feminine plural?
sarf.back: An alif after its nūn — <bdi>يَفْتَحْنَانِّ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.front: What vowel does <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد الثَّقِيلَة</bdi> take?
sarf.back: A fatḥah — except after an alif (the dual and the feminine plural), where it takes a kasrah: <bdi>يَفْتَحَانِّ</bdi>, <bdi>يَفْتَحْنَانِّ</bdi>

sarf.source: IOK Arabic — Ṣarf: the derived nouns' patterns, nūn al-tawkīd — class notes 2026-10-08
sarf.extra: With <bdi>نُون التَّوْكِيد الثَّقِيلَة</bdi>. The other nine forms follow these five shapes.
